title: Add group.leave() and client.leaveGroup() for graceful MLS departure
body:
![marmot](https://blossom.primal.net/95e31ce5ce8f925c19972b05a50722053ec5dc8ddd0f6642e90d066b70f0ea15.png)

This marmot is packing up and heading out — gracefully, of course. Adds `MarmotGroup.leave()` which publishes a self-remove proposal for each of the caller's leaf nodes (per RFC 9420 §12.4, a member cannot commit their own removal, so proposals are sent for the next admin commit to pick up) and then purges all local group state once at least one relay acks. Also adds `MarmotClient.leaveGroup(groupId)` which calls `leave()`, evicts the group from the in-memory cache, and emits `groupLeft` and `groupsUpdated` events. The leave proposal logic lives in a new `proposeLeaveGroup` action in `src/client/group/proposals/leave-group.ts`, consistent with the existing proposals pattern.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added leaveGroup() method to enable group departure
  * Added groupLeft event emitted when a member leaves a group
  * Added leave() method on group objects for direct exit

* **Tests**
  * Added comprehensive test suite for group departure functionality and relay handling

title: fix: MIP compliance gaps — retries, NIP-70, welcome failures, key rotation
body:
## Summary

Addresses five MIP compliance gaps found during a cross-implementation audit of pika, Vector, and marmot-ts:

- **NIP-70 protected tags on key packages (MIP-00)** — kind 443 events now include the `["-"]` tag to prevent relay tag stripping
- **Retry on relay publish failure** — `publishWithRetries()` with 5-attempt exponential backoff for `commit()` and `sendApplicationRumor()`; retries auth/protected errors and transport failures
- **Welcome publish failures surfaced** — `commit()` now checks `Promise.allSettled` results and throws when Welcome delivery fails, instead of silently swallowing
- **Post-join self-update for admins (MIP-02)** — admin joiners send an empty commit after `joinGroupFromWelcome()` to rotate leaf keys for forward secrecy
- **Key package rotation API (MIP-00)** — `MarmotClient.rotateKeyPackage()` generates fresh init keys and returns unsigned event templates (kind 443 + NIP-09 delete)

### Not included: non-admin post-join self-update

MIP-02 expects all joiners to self-update within 24 hours. Non-admin joiners would need to send an Update proposal, but ts-mls does not currently retain the new HPKE private key in `privatePath` for externally-constructed `ProposalUpdate` objects. When the admin's commit applies the Update, `applyUpdatePathSecret` tries to decrypt with the old key against ciphertext encrypted to the new public key — decryption fails and the proposer's group state breaks.

This needs a ts-mls `createSelfUpdateProposal()` helper that internally manages both old and new HPKE private keys until the resolving commit is processed.

## Test plan

- [x] `tsc --noEmit` passes with no errors
- [x] `vitest run` — 146/146 tests pass (export snapshot updated)
- [ ] Manual: create group, invite member → Welcome arrives only after commit is relay-confirmed
- [ ] Manual: publish to unreachable relay → retries with backoff, fails with descriptive error
- [ ] Manual: key package event includes `["-"]` tag

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Key package rotation: generate new key packages and unsigned event templates for publishing (new public method).
  * Publish retry utility: exponential-backoff publishWithRetries exposed as a public helper.
  * Optional NIP-70 protected tagging for key-package events.
  * Post-join self-update: best-effort self-commit after joining via Welcome.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved error handling and explicit surfacing of publish/relay and welcome delivery failures.

* **Tests**

title: Message history
body:
This PR adds a new `GroupHistoryStore` interface and `history` field to the `MarmotGroup` class. the interface is a generic type on the class or that the app can override it with a custom class that handles MLS message history in a custom way (better loading for UI / live events)

I then added a `MarmotGroupHistoryStore` group history storage class that only saves the MIP-03 rumors from the MLS messages to a backend. this is intended to be used by most marmot apps since they only care about valid nostr rumor events and not other stuff that could be sent over MLS

The chat app them implements a `idb` based backend for storing group rumor messages and then provides that to the `MarmotClient` class so it can be pass down to the `MarmotGroup` class for `group.history`

The main chat view is now updated to use a `useGroupMessages` hook that only uses the `group.history` interface to listen for new messages and load old messages (via pagination)

title: Proposals and commit
body:
Restructuring the proposal process again based on discussions. 

This PR adds a `MarmotGroup.propose` method that takes one of the proposal builders in the `proposals` folder. then it wraps the proposal in a MLSMessage and then in a group message event and publishes it

On the admin side there is a new `MarmotGroup.commit` method which takes an array of `Proposal`s or proposal builders and then preforms the necessary MLS calls to create the publish it to relays

Breaking the flow into "proposal builders" and "commit" should allow non-admin members to create and send proposals to admins and admins to accept proposals and create their own and then commit them

body: - Update the key package generation process to ensure compliance with MIP-00 by integrating last resort and Marmot Group Data extensions. - Updated the `generateKeyPackage` function to accept custom capabilities, lifetime, and extensions while ensuring required extensions are included. - Improved the handling of default capabilities to automatically include necessary extensions. Key packages created using marmot-ts now look like The `capabilities` now - Only include `basic` credential type - `capabilities.extensions` now includes last_resort `0x000a` and marmot group data `0xf2ee` - key package now include an empty last_resort extension Only thing I'm not sure is that the leaf node includes the last_resort extension, which I'm certain is incorrect since that extension is only supposed to be on key packages and not leaf nodes or groups ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Simplified key-package creation with guaranteed "last-resort" extension and a three-month lifetime helper. * Key Packages modal plus a "Key Packages" side-nav button showing live counts; view, lazy-load, and clear local key packages. * Storage now persists only after successful publication and UI updates reactively across the app. * **Tests** * Expanded coverage for key-package creation, extension handling, capability transformations, and public exports.

title: refactor(ext): remove explicit default extensions from key packages
body:
According to MLS spec, default extensions (ratchet_tree, required_capabilities, etc.) are implicitly supported by all implementations and MUST NOT be listed in capabilities. This removes the explicit creation of required_capabilities and ratchet_tree extensions from keyPackageDefaultExtensions(), relying instead on implicit support.

- Remove createRequiredCapabilitiesExtension() function
- Update tests to expect only custom marmot_group_data extension
- Update keyPackageDefaultExtensions() to only include marmot_group_data
- Remove corresponding imports from key-package.ts and extensions.ts

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Refactor**
  * Simplified default MLS extensions for key packages to include only essential extensions.

title: Reorganize `src` folder
body:
## Reorganize
I reorganized the `src` folder into three main folders
 - `core` - Anything that can be described as core methods for the marmot-ts package
 - `extra` - stuff that doesn't fit into the library but still maybe useful (probably shouldn't export this from the main `src/index.ts`
 - `utils` - grouped utility methods for handling nostr events / arrays / strings and other **small** things
 
 ## Basic Key Package Store
Sketched out a simple class that wraps a generic async key/value store that can be used to store key packages. This is necessary just yet but I wanted to start experimenting with making the examples create and store key packages between browser reloads

There is also a (probably bad) `EncryptedKeyValueStore` class in the `extra` folder. this was copied from another project and isn't necessary but I wanted to include it as an example of how the async key/value storage interface can be wrapped and extended

## Credential methods
Added two simple methods to create a MIP-00 credential or reading the nostr pubkey from an existing credential.

The `getCredentialPubkey` method include backwards compatibility with reading pubkeys encoded as utf8, this can be removed once MDK publishes a release that no longer encodes keys as utf8 

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a persistent key-package storage system, an encrypted password-protected layer for sensitive key data, UI preview modal for viewing formatted key package/events, credential validation indicators in the explorer, and improved empty-state + responsive contacts grid.

* **Public API**
  * New storage and credential-related APIs exposed for managing and inspecting key packages.

* **Tests**
  * Expanded unit and integration tests for credential creation, extraction, validation, and edge cases.

* **Dependencies**
  * Added a cryptographic hashing library.
